name: Status Mark
description: Small animated status icon with optional label. Morphs between pending, in progress (spinner or progress ring), completed (check), failed and cancelled (cross), with strikethrough on done.
contents: SVG ring icon with check and cross paths
Optional text label with strikethrough line on completion
behavior: Ring morphs from dashed (pending) to solid arc (running, done, failed) with spring and eased motion
Running without progress spins an indeterminate arc, with a progress number it fills the ring to that fraction
Done draws a check in the done color, failed draws a cross in the error color, cancelled draws a cross in the base color
Label is struck through on done when strike is true
Reduced motion disables spinning and morphing, indeterminate state breathes by opacity instead
editableByProps: Status, progress fraction and label text
Colors for base, done and error states
Icon size, stroke width, dash count, label font size
Spin speed, arc length, check draw duration, fill opacity, strikethrough on or off and its delay

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the spoken status names or add a status
needsCodeEdit.where: TEXT constant and the group-data-[status=...] classes

fixed: Inline-flex element with no frame, sized by the size prop
Cancelled status keeps the base color and dims the label
Spoken status text is hardcoded in English in the TEXT constant
Injects a small style tag for the sm-breathe keyframes
Works at all screen sizes, no hover interaction
